text:
Coordinator: At dusk, the departures lead needs help. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is sorting late bookings and checking carrier notes.
Planner: Keep the intake clear and push any special care flags to the cabin team. We need a clean handoff from booking through pickup.
Dispatcher: I am reviewing kennel space and document packets for Aurelia Skyways. Missing forms should go back to the sender at once.
Coordinator: The welcome team can stage the boarding area and confirm labels before each handoff. Bruno should stay on the quiet side if he is on the list.
Planner: Layla Shah and Jonah Fischer both need steady updates on check in and arrival steps. Keep the language calm and brief.
Handler: I will match feeding notes with carrier tags and pass the rest to the flight team. Any mismatch should be logged right away.
Dispatcher: The cabin team will watch the animals in flight and report any issue through the desk channel. We should keep a clear trail for each traveler.
Planner: Once landing is confirmed, the pickup side takes over and checks the release details. That keeps the flow smooth for every pet.
Coordinator: Hold the desk steady and avoid extra noise around the gates. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will close the loop cleanly tonight.
